title: `Error trying to diff ‘[object Object]'` needs to pass the error message

labels.name: area: core
labels.description: Issues related to the framework runtime

body:

**Current behavior**
`Error trying to diff ‘[object Object]'` Does not say what the actual error is. Once you get this, the path forward relies on diving into the angular source code since the error message was erased.

**Expected behavior**
`Error trying to diff ‘[object Object]': ReferenceError: Invalid left-hand side in assignment` Does not drop the actual reason there was an exception raised.

**Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions**
Unknown how to minimally reproduce, specifically because the error message is dropped.  This is in fact, the exact problem.

**What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior?**
Dedicate time to fixing the problem instead of everyone needing to go into the angular source code when the bug is probably (but don't know) in their own project.

**Please tell us about your environment:**
Ubuntu 16.04LTE, geany 1.27, ionic2

* **Angular version:** 2.2.1

* **Browser:** all
 
* **Language:** TypeScript 2.0.10

* **Node (for AoT issues):** `node --version` =  6.9.2
